label: KITCHEN
idea: A ghost kitchen in Lagos, Nigeria that delivers Nigerian home-style lunches (jollof, egusi, moi moi) to office workers who order over WhatsApp before 10am.

steps.title: A Ghost Kitchen in Lagos, Nigeria

copilot.reply: So, you want to validate the demand for your Nigerian home-style lunch delivery service in Lagos, targeting office workers who order via WhatsApp before 10am. You're concerned about whether this concept can be scalable and profitable. Can you tell me more about the average order value and frequency of orders from these office workers?
